answer_1.quote: We manually annotated, using the procedure of ..., 90 texts produced by three neural NLG systems that use basketball box score data...

answer_2.quote: The submissions were evaluated by computing their recall and precision against the gold-standard mistake list (GSML) which was based on the human annotated texts in the test set...

answer_4.quote: In earlier work, we developed a protocol where three Mechanical Turk workers (who had been screened and passed a qualifying test) carefully annotated factual errors in a text produced by a neural NLG system.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to identify factual errors, mark their span (start and end token) and assign one of the predefined categories (Incorrect number, Incorrect name, Incorrect word, Context error, Not checkable, Other).
